svg.aria-label: One frame of the particles: begin, emit, simulate and end run in compute with a barrier after each, begin sizing the emit and simulate dispatches and end writing the draw's arguments. Then the counters are copied out, the scene pass draws the ground, and the particle pass draws with one indirect draw.
